card.name: Inside math formulas, before closing parentheses
card.fires_on: Tokens inside parenthesized math expressions, such as a variable or number just before a closing bracket and an operator. It also fires on a few mid-name pieces of rare surnames.

modes.label: Math expressions
modes.description: Pieces inside parentheses in algebra or formulas, where a closing bracket and an operator come next.

modes.label: Clinical formula
modes.description: The end of the word creatinine inside the eGFR equation.

modes.label: Surname pieces
modes.description: Middle or starting pieces of unusual personal names.
modes.example: Eugene B<<oud>>in Prize is an award

card.writes: It suppresses closing-parenthesis-plus-operator tokens, so it steers the output away from ending a bracket and moving to an operator.
card.plain: It lights up inside written-out math formulas, such as the kidney function equation, and on pieces of odd names.
